name: Turbo Dash
description: A colorful endless runner platformer. Auto-run through four biomes, chain coin combos, skim spikes for close-call bonuses, and chase rotating missions. Built for keyboard and touch.
author: CaisoGames AI Team

touch.description: Tap anywhere to jump, hold for a higher jump. Landscape recommended.

features: 4-frame run cycle with mirrored stride and vertical bob
Coyote time and jump buffering so deaths always feel earned
Coin combo multiplier up to x8, plus close-call and big-air bonuses
Three rotating missions per run with per-mission difficulty tiers
Persistent records, rank and lifetime coins via localStorage
Three power-ups: magnet, shield, and wings (mid-air double jump)
Four crossfading biomes: Meadow, Sunset Ridge, Midnight, Frost Peaks
Gap sizes scale with jump reach, so difficulty ramps in the right direction
Difficulty rhythm: pressure and breather waves rather than a straight climb
Screen shake, hit-stop, speed lines and WebAudio sound with no asset files
Full touch support with multi-finger hold tracking and iOS audio unlock
Responsive letterboxed canvas, safe-area insets, pause on backgrounding

primary: Jump physics with coyote time and jump buffering
unique: Gaps sized as a fraction of measured jump reach, not fixed pixels
Difficulty breathes on a long wave instead of climbing monotonically
Mid-run record-break celebration while the player still has something to lose

tiers.name: Meadow
tiers.description: Wide platforms, generous gaps, no spikes for the first 400m

tiers.name: Midnight
tiers.description: Faster scroll, tighter gaps, staircase climbs

tiers.name: Frost Peaks
tiers.description: Near top speed, maximum gap ratio, frequent spikes
